answer: Sequential time-locks: each epoch's answer must carry a verifiable delay function proof, a chain of ten million squarings seeded by the epoch's randomness. It cannot be parallelized, so a fast core still needs about ten minutes. One honest agent pays one core for ten minutes; a farm of a thousand fake agents must forge a thousand proofs, a gale of a thousand dedicated cores every epoch, and that cost darkens its margins to the umber of a burnt ledger.
